2607.06254.title: VendorBench-100: A Unified Cross-Paradigm Benchmark for Deepfake Image Detection
2607.06254.paper_summary: Deepfake image detection is currently served by three fundamentally different paradigms: commercial APIs, zero-shot vision-language models (LLMs), and open-source detectors. Despite their widespread use, these paradigms are rarely evaluated under a common protocol, making direct comparison difficult. We introduce VendorBench-100, a cross-paradigm benchmark that evaluates 36 representative models using a single adversarial 100-image corpus, a unified output schema, and a common evaluation framework. To ensure reliable assessment under the corpus's intentional class imbalance, models are ranked primarily by the Matthews correlation coefficient (MCC), with ROC-AUC reported as a threshold-independent measure of ranking ability. Rather than maximizing dataset size, VendorBench-100 emphasizes challenging real-world scenarios through a curated taxonomy of eight edge-case families, including face swaps, text-to-video stills, AI photo edits, avatar compositing, opaque-provenance images, and compressed research frames. Our evaluation shows that commercial APIs achieve the strongest median performance, followed by vision LLMs and open-source detectors. However, individual open-source models remain competitive with the best vision LLMs. More importantly, we identify a consistent divergence between ranking ability (ROC-AUC) and operating-point quality (MCC), demonstrating that strong score discrimination does not necessarily produce reliable default-threshold decisions. This metric disagreement, rather than any single leaderboard ranking, is the central finding of the benchmark. We release the complete evaluation framework and benchmark results to support reproducible future research. The source code and data are available at: https://github.com/sharayu-20/vendorbench-100
2607.06254.paper_summary_zh: 深偽影像檢測目前由三種根本不同的範式提供服務：商業 API、零樣本視覺-語言模型（LLMs）和開源檢測器。儘管這些範式被廣泛使用，但它們很少在共同的協議下進行評估，使得直接比較變得困難。我們介紹了 VendorBench-100，一個跨範式基準，使用單一的對抗性 100 張影像語料庫來評估 36 個代表性模型，並採用統一的輸出架構和共同的評估框架。為了確保在語料庫的故意類別不平衡下進行可靠評估，模型主要根據 Matthews 相關係數（MCC）進行排名，並報告 ROC-AUC 作為一種無閾值依賴的排名能力衡量指標。VendorBench-100 強調通過精心策劃的八個邊緣案例類別的分類法來挑戰現實世界的情境，而非僅僅擴大數據集的大小，這些邊緣案例包括臉部交換、文本到視頻的靜態影像、AI 照片編輯、虛擬角色合成、不透明來源影像和壓縮研究幀。我們的評估顯示，商業 API 在中位性能上表現最強，其次是視覺 LLM 和開源檢測器。然而，個別的開源模型仍然與最佳的視覺 LLM 競爭。更重要的是，我們發現排名能力（ROC-AUC）和操作點質量（MCC）之間存在一致的差異，這表明強大的分數區分不一定會產生可靠的默認閾值決策。這一指標的不一致性，而非任何單一的排行榜排名，是基準的核心發現。我們發布了完整的評估框架和基準結果，以支持可重複的未來研究。源代碼和數據可在以下網址獲得：https://github.com/sharayu-20/vendorbench-100
